title: Jesus... My Friend Borrowed Money Again
topic: her friend keeps borrowing money and she cannot bring herself to say no even though it weighs on her

bible.text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my friend asked to borrow money again. Why can't I say no? 💸

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I checked my balance twice before sending it. He never mentioned the last one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You gave him the money easily and the honesty never.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Isn't refusing him unkind? He is struggling too.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A yes you resent helps no one. A true no leaves the friendship alive.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Generosity with a boundary is still generosity.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: How do you say no to a friend who borrows? 👇
